text: The nicotine in cigarettes is the substance that causes most of the cancer.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.note: VERIFY: 49% agree and 27% disagree come from HINTS Brief 37; the 24% don't-know share is inferred, not seen. Confirm all response options and the exact wording. 2015 survey; older data.

truthSource.label: FDA, Nicotine Is Why Tobacco Products Are Addictive
truthSource.oneLine: Nicotine is what makes tobacco addictive, but most of the cancer comes from the thousands of other chemicals in tobacco smoke.
